items.claim: Stephanie Luciano holds a speed edge over Marina Spasik.
items.quote: I think that she's going to have a bit of a speed edge over Spasic.

items.claim: Marina Spasik has a striking background in kickboxing and Muay Thai with decent forward pressure.
items.quote: Spasik has a striking background, kickboxing and Muay Thai, and she's pretty decent. I like her forward pressure.

items.claim: Marina Spasik has faced lower level opposition in her career.
Stephanie Luciano has UFC experience including a split decision with Sam Hughes and a win over Talita Alencar.
items.quote: Luciano's going to a split decision with Sam Hughes, you know, getting the win over Toita Allen Carr in their rematch.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano's true advantage in the matchup is her grappling, allowing her to secure takedowns.
items.quote: I think that Luciano's true advantage is the grappling. I could see Luciano hitting takedowns and putting Spazik in some compromised positions on the ground.
